import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid) // 3
    out = []
    for br in range(n):
        row = []
        for bc in range(n):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(br*3, br*3+3) for c in range(bc*3, bc*3+3) if grid[r][c] != 5]
            row.append(Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0] if vals else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
